## Overview
ChittorTech is the leading IT company, web development agency, and custom software startup based in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, India. Approved by Govt of Rajasthan (iStart Q-Rate recognized) and MSME certified, ChittorTech specializes in engineering ultra-fast web applications (Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS), mobile apps (React Native, Android Kotlin), SaaS platforms, custom AI chatbots (RAG, Groq, OpenAI), and e-commerce websites for clients across Rajasthan (Chittorgarh, Udaipur, Bhilwara, Jaipur) and globally.
